title: 有才华的人之 音乐人
cue:
Describe a famous musician.
You should say：
who this musician is
how the musician became famous
what is special about his / her music
and explain how you feel about this musician.
a:
I'd like to talk about one of the most successful musicians in the world, Yo-Yo Ma.

He was a child prodigy. He took his first cello lesson at the age of four and he performed for John F. Kennedy in the White House when he was seven. Now he's considered to be one of the greatest cellists alive. As far as I know（据我所知，表示自己并不是非常清楚准确的情况，说 Part 2 时其实并不需要总像是该领域的权威似的，因为没有人会是所有问题上的专家）, he has recorded around 100 albums and has received 18 Grammy Awards.

Yo-Yo Ma tours the world playing his cello, and he always looks for new ways to express himself. He not only plays classical music but also plays country music, Chinese folk music and African music. He likes to perform on stage with other musicians as well. Wherever he performs, people are touched by his music. And he always receives huge applause and cheers at the end of his performances.

I'm a fan of Yo-Yo Ma because he's very talented and creative. Also, he's humble and modest, and really respects his audience. He often says to his audience, “To me, playing music is about learning forever.” And he is very dedicated to his work, so he's a good role model for young people.
vocab: 大提琴(cellist 是大提琴演奏家)
is a good role model for young people

title: 有才华的人之 艺术家
a:
I'm going to talk about an artist I admire, Vincent Van Gogh（梵高）. He was a 19th-century Dutch painter.

Van Gogh was very talented and creative. Instead of just trying to copy what he saw, he used colours freely in order to better express his feelings. His painting style influenced and inspired many other painters. And now he's considered one of the greatest artists in history.

I admire Van Gogh not only because he was talented but also because he had great sympathy for the poor. He often painted farmers and workers in his paintings. He even gave away most of his own money to help people who lived poverty.

Unfortunately, Van Gogh sold only one painting during his lifetime. But in my opinion, he's much more than a great painter. He's one of the greatest cultural heroes of modern times.
